caption: An exact tie rounds to the even digit: 0.125 to 0.12
sage.note: The mapping evaluates at Sage's own precision and drops N's digit count, so 1/8 prints 0.125000000000000 where N(1/8, 2) rounds to even, 0.12.
sympy.note: The mapping evaluates at the system's own precision and drops N's digit count, so 1/8 prints 0.125 where N(1/8, 2) rounds to even, 0.12.
mpmath.note: The mapping evaluates at the system's own precision and drops N's digit count, so it prints every digit.
oscar.note: Oscar's input is already numeric and N's digit count is dropped, so it prints the untruncated 0.125; at this exact tie that differs from compute-engine's round-half-to-even N(1/8, 2) = 0.12.
julia.note: N's digit count is dropped for Julia — it's numeric already, per the mapping's own note. At this exact tie the untruncated 0.125 differs from our round-half-to-even N(1/8, 2) = 0.12.
rust.note: The mapping evaluates at the system's own precision and drops N's digit count, so 1/8 prints 0.125 where N(1/8, 2) rounds to even, 0.12.
